senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (धमति)
1 To blow, as a wind instrument, to produce sound by blowing.
2 To blow a fire, to excite fire by blowing.
3 To apply fire.
4 To excite sparks.

m. (-रः)
A blacksmith.
E.
ध्मा blowing, from ध्मा to blow, affix क्विप्, and कार who makes.

(इ) ध्माक्षि r. 1st cl. (ध्मांक्षति)
1 To desire.
2 To crow or caw: see ध्राक्ष and ध्वाक्ष.

m. (-क्षः)
1 Any aquatic bird.
2 A crow, &c.
E.
ध्माक्ष to crow or caw, अच् affix; more usually read ध्वाङ्क्ष, q. v.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तुं)
1 Inflamed, excited.
2 Blown into or up, inflated.
3 Blown by a bellows, (a fire, &c.)
E.
ध्मा to blow, &c. affix क्त.

m. (-मा)
1 Measure.
2 Light.
3 Meditation.
E.
ध्मा to blow or breathe, Uṇādi affix मन्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being melted or refined.
2 Being inflated.
E.
ध्मा to blow, शानच् aff.
